## Instructions for how to run the DBs locally

1. clone the repo
2. run `python local_config.py --config=<apache2_config_file>`  
    i.e. for a normal build `python local_config.py --config=/etc/apache2/sites-enabled/dev_website.conf`  
    or for a production build `python local_config.py --config=/etc/apache2/sites-enabled/live_website.conf`
3. mv the live/dev.wsgi file and paste it in the root folder (don't know why that's needed)
4. run `source settings.sh`
    This also means we can no longer use Apache
